blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Text-to-video retrieval usually represents a video clip by a single
embedding. This embedding often loses important relations between people. E.g., an interaction “Anna confronts Mark” is regularly filmed as alternating shot and reverse shot of both (Fig. 1 a). No single shot or averaged embedding over clip shots captures this relation. Thus, we propose SALI (Shot-Aware Late Interaction). It extracts the subject and object from a single-sentence query, and matches the query, its subject and object text embeddings against each visual shot embedding of a video clip. The matching operator is greedy max or optimal transport. A film-grammar penalty in fine-tuning adds a small, consistent shift. Built on CLIP4Clip-meanP, SALI keeps overall recall on par on Condensed Movies and ActivityNet while raising R@1 on multi-shot relation queries by 3 and 12 points, the most among all compared methods, and improves such queries on MSR-VTT at a cost of 1.4 R@1 overall.
blocks.zh:
文本到视频检索通常代表一个视频片段
内嵌. 这种嵌入往往会失去人与人之间的重要关系. 例如,“Anna对抗Mark”互动经常被拍摄为两者交替拍摄和反拍(图1a)。 任何单一镜头或平均嵌入在剪辑镜头上都无法捕捉到这种关联. 因此,我们提议使用SALI(Shot-Award Late Interactive)。 它从一个单一的判罚查询中提取主题和对象,并与查询,其主题和对象文本的嵌入相对应每个视频片段嵌入的视觉镜头. 匹配的运算符是贪婪的最大或最佳运输. 微调中的电影语法惩罚增加了一个小的,一贯的转变. 在CLIP4Clip-meanP上,SALI保持了对Condensed Movies and ActivityNet上等值的整体召回,同时将多镜头关系查询中的R@1提升到3和12点,这是所有比较方法中最优的,并且以1.4 R@1的总成本改进了MSR-VTT上的此类查询.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Film grammar breaks single-embedding and per-shot matching. (a) An interaction between two people is filmed as alternating shot and reverse shot: no single shot shows the relation. (b) Per-shot max gives the true video and a one-shot look-alike the same score. (c) Mean pooling averages the shots into one vector and dilutes the relation. (d) SALI matches the subject and the object to different shots.
blocks.zh: 图 1:电影语法打破单嵌和每镜头匹配. (a) 两个人之间的互动被拍成交替射击和反射击:没有一枪显示这种关系。 (b) 每枪最大分数给出真实的视频和一枪相似的外观。 (c) 平均将射入一个矢量并稀释关系。 (d) SALI与主体和物体匹配不同的镜头。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Text-to-video retrieval (T2VR) ranks a gallery of videos by relevance to a text query. Most recent systems build on CLIP [ 1 ] and represent the whole clip by one vector, the mean over all frame embeddings [ 2 ] . Finer-grained alternatives compare the text embedding with each frame embedding [ 3 , 4 ] or each query-word embedding with each frame embedding [ 5 ] . All treat a video as a bag or sequence of frames, but movies and dramas are organized by camera cuts into shots and scenes [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] , with dozens of shots per two-minute clip (Table 1 ). This setting, single-sentence queries against clips of tens of shots, is the one we address. A single video clip embedding ignores this structure. We call this gap between the clip’s structure and its single embedding the single-video-embedding gap . Because of it, retrieval on movies and dramas degrades.
blocks.zh: 文本到视频检索(T2VR)按文本查询的相关程度排列了视频的画廊. 最近的系统基于CLIP [1],以一个矢量代表整个剪辑,所有帧的平均值嵌入[2]. Fineer-Grained 替代品将文本嵌入与每个帧嵌入[3,4]或每个查询词嵌入与每个帧嵌入[5]进行比较. 所有视频都作为包或帧的序列来对待,但电影和剧情则由镜头切片组织成镜头和场景[6,7,8,9],每两分钟的片段有几十个镜头(表1). 这个场景,对数十发子弹片段的 单一判决的询问,就是我们讨论的。 一个嵌入的视频片段忽略了这个结构. 我们称片段结构与它单一嵌入的片段之间有差距。 由于这个原因,电影和戏剧上的检索退化.

blocks.en: The failure is not just that long videos dilute local evidence: film grammar [ 10 ] places the evidence in a specific way. An interaction between two people—“Anna confronts Mark”—is regularly filmed as alternating shot and reverse shot [ 11 ] : one shot shows Anna, the next Mark, and no single shot depicts the relation itself (Fig. 1 a). Per-shot matching therefore cannot separate the true video from a look-alike with one similar shot (Fig. 1 b), and mean pooling dilutes the relation (Fig. 1 c). Sec. 2 shows that zero-shot CLIP degrades most on queries about relations between people when the video clip has many shots.
blocks.zh: 失败不仅仅是长视频稀释了当地证据:电影语法[10]将证据放在特定的方式. 两个人之间的互动——“Anna对抗Mark”——经常被拍摄为交替拍摄和反拍摄[11]: 一个镜头 Anna,下一个Mark,没有一枪描绘关系本身(图1 a). 因此,每个镜头匹配无法将真实视频与一个类似镜头的外观相分离(图1b),意味着集合会淡化关系(图1c). sec.2显示,当视频片段有许多镜头时,零镜头的CLIP在询问人与人之间的关系时,降解最多.

blocks.en: The closest idea is late interaction [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] : a video is represented by many vectors, one per frame or token, and each query token is matched to its most similar vector. The similarities are combined into one score by max, by learned or attention weights [ 15 , 5 ] , or by optimal transport (OT) [ 16 , 17 ] . Such matcher finds “Anna” and “Mark” separately but never asks how they appear in the query.
blocks.zh: 最接近的想法是迟到的互动[12,13,14]: 视频由许多向量代表,每个帧或令牌各一个,每个查询令牌都与其最相似的向量匹配. 相似之处按最大分数、学得的或注意力的重量[15、5]或最佳运输(OT)[16、17]合并为一个分数。 这种匹配者发现“Anna”和“Mark”是分开的,但从未问过它们是如何出现在查询中。

blocks.en:
We close the single-video-embedding gap with SALI (Shot-Aware Late
Interaction), contributing: (1) a diagnosis on Condensed Movies [ 6 ] showing that a single video embedding fails specifically on queries about
relations between people over many-shot videos; (2) SALI , which keeps one embedding per shot and matches the complete query, its subject and its object against the shots with a matching operator 1 1 1 A matching operator is the rule that turns the similarities between the three CLIP text embeddings and the shot embeddings into one score. , greedy max or optimal transport; (3) an analysis of which matching operator to use at training and at inference, showing that the gains on relational queries come from greedy max at inference while a film-grammar penalty in fine-tuning adds a small, consistent shift.

blocks.en: 2 Diagnosis: does the problem exist?
blocks.zh: 2 诊断:问题是否存在?

blocks.en: Benchmarks. Existing T2VR benchmarks differ in what a video is: a short web clip (MSR-VTT [ 18 ] ), an untrimmed activity video with a paragraph caption (ActivityNet Captions [ 19 ] ), a movie segment of a few seconds (LSMDC [ 7 ] , MAD [ 8 ] ), or a two-minute movie scene with a caption about its characters (Condensed Movies, CM [ 6 ] ). Table 1 shows their number of shots per video and the share of relational queries , i.e., queries with a verb from a list of 11 interpersonal verbs and two person nouns or pronouns. CM is our primary testbed.
blocks.zh: 基准。 现有的T2VR基准在视频内容上有所不同:短网剪辑(MSR-VTT [18]),带有段落字幕(ActivityNet Captions [19])的未剪辑活动视频,几秒钟的电影片段(LSMDC [7],MAD [8]),或两分钟的电影片段,其人物字幕. (凝聚电影,CM [6]. 表1显示他们每段视频的镜头数和关系查询的比例,即用11个人际动词和2个人名词或代词列表中的动词查询. CM是我们的主要测试床。

blocks.en: Where T2VR fails. We test our hypothesis that a single video embedding fails specifically when the query describes a relation between two people and the video spreads that relation over many shots. Our diagnosis has four steps. (1) Pool : all 10,621 obtainable CM videos (Sec. 4 ), each with its caption as the query and the video as the only correct answer (5.0% of the queries are relational). (2) Retrieval : zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/16 [ 1 ] with one vector per video (the mean of its shot means), so that the result reflects CLIP itself. (3) Split : queries into relational vs. non-relational, videos into quartiles by shot count. (4) Measure : R@10 (%) per quartile of the matching video. For relational queries it falls from 28.3 in the fewest-shot quartile to 14.8 in the most-shot quartile ( − 13.5 -13.5 ). For non-relational queries it falls only from 23.5 to 18.2 ( − 5.3 -5.3 ). A single video embedding thus fails specifically on relational queries over many-shot videos. We therefore evaluate on Rel-Multi , the relational queries whose videos have at least the median shot count (34 shots).
blocks.zh: T2VR 失败的地方 。 我们测试我们的假设,即当询问中描述两个人之间的关系时,一个单一的视频嵌入会特别失败,而视频将这种关系传播到许多镜头上. 我们的诊断有四个步骤。 (1) Pool:所有10 621个可获取的CM视频(第4节),每个视频的标题作为查询,视频作为唯一的正确答案(5.0%的查询是关系性的)。 (2)检索 :零镜头 CLIP VIT-B/16 [1] 每段视频带1个矢量(其射击的平均值表示),这样结果就反映了CLIP本身. blocks.en: Shot and query embeddings (Fig. 2 ). A video is split into S S shots by an off-the-shelf shot-boundary detector (PySceneDetect [ 20 ] ). Each frame is encoded by CLIP’s [ 1 ] image encoder. The mean of the frame embeddings of shot k k is its shot embedding v k v_{k} , and the S S shot embeddings form the video feature tensor V ∈ ℝ S × d V\in\mathbb{R}^{S\times d} . On the query side we use the same list of interpersonal verbs as in Sec. 2 (11 hand-selected patterns such as confronts , talks to , looks at ). The verb splits the sentence: the words before it form the subject span and the words after it the object span. The full query and the two spans are encoded by the same CLIP text encoder into three text embeddings q full q_{\mathrm{full}} , q subj q_{\mathrm{subj}} and q obj q_{\mathrm{obj}} . Queries without such a verb use q subj = q obj = q full q_{\mathrm{subj}}{=}q_{\mathrm{obj}}{=}q_{\mathrm{full}} . Text and shot embeddings pass through linear projections p q p_{q} (shared by the three text embeddings) and p v p_{v} , both initialized as the identity matrix.

blocks.en: Film-grammar penalty. Offline, faces are embedded [ 22 ] and clustered across shots (cosine similarity > 0.4 >0.4 ). Each shot takes the identity of its largest face, which gives the same-person matrix P ∈ { 0 , 1 } S × S P\in\{0,1\}^{S\times S} with P k ​ l = 1 P_{kl}{=}1 iff shots k k and l l show the same person. P P is used only in the training loss, so inference needs no face pipeline. The two penalties follow from shot/reverse-shot editing [ 11 ] . P1: Same-shot penalty. Each shot centers on one person, so the subject and the object being matched to the same shot indicates a look-alike rather than the relation. P2: Same-person penalty. The subject and the object are different characters, so the two being matched to shots that show the same person ( P k ​ l = 1 P_{kl}{=}1 ) contradicts the query. blocks.en: Score and training. The clip-level score s clip s_{\mathrm{clip}} is the cosine between the projected q full q_{\mathrm{full}} and the projected mean of all frame embeddings, with its own identity-initialized projections. So it equals CLIP4Clip-meanP [ 2 ] at the start of fine-tuning. It is mixed with the shot-level score s s of Eq. 1 by a learned gate g g : s ^ = g ​ s + ( 1 − g ) ​ s clip \hat{s}=g\,s+(1{-}g)\,s_{\mathrm{clip}} . g g is one scalar per query type (with or without an interpersonal verb), initialized near 0.5 0.5 . The model is trained with symmetric InfoNCE [ 2 ] over s ^ \hat{s} while both CLIP towers are fine-tuned. The penalty is part of this objective, not a set of hard negatives [ 23 ] . At inference, the trained model is used unchanged; the matching operator is either greedy max or OT (Table 2 ).

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
Datasets and protocols. Of the 34,185 clips in the released catalog of CM [ 6 ] , 10,621 (31.1%) are still obtainable: 8,499 from official train movies, 846 from val movies and 1,276 from test movies. Relational captions are only about 6% of CM, and the official test movies contain only 48 Rel-Multi queries (Table 1 ), so we build a larger evaluation gallery that shares no movie with the training set: all 2,122 val- and test-movie clips plus 140 train-movie clips selected by caption to add relational queries, 2,262 clips in total with 203 relational queries (113 in Rel-Multi). We train on 7,073 of the remaining train-movie clips (1,221 movies); 724 clips of 136 further train movies form our validation split (val) for epoch selection. The other 562, selected with the 140, share a movie with the training set and are used for neither training nor evaluation. ActivityNet
Captions [ 19 ] (val_1, the standard test split [ 2 ] ) and
MSR-VTT [ 18 ] (1k-A test [ 24 ] ) are the
generalization datasets (Table 4 ); on both, 10% of the training videos are used as val. Person nouns (Sec. 2 ) include capitalized non-initial tokens. Rel-Multi requires the median shot count of Table 1 (34 on CM, 4 on ActivityNet, which has fewer shots per video), and MSR-VTT keeps the relational subset only.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Training. All systems share CLIP ViT-B/16 [ 1 ] and the same official number of frames per video (128 on CM; 64 on ActivityNet and 12 on MSR-VTT, the
released defaults). SALI regroups those frames by the shot their
timestamp falls in ( ≈ \approx 3.6 frames per shot on CM). SALI is warm-started from a CLIP4Clip-meanP [ 2 ] checkpoint trained with the official implementation on this split, and both
towers are fine-tuned for 4 epochs
(AdamW, 10 − 7 10^{-7} backbone / 10 − 4 10^{-4} head, batch 48, symmetric InfoNCE,
3 seeds). The baselines (CLIP4Clip [ 2 ] , X-CLIP [ 5 ] , TS2-Net [ 4 ] ) are run with their official implementations on this split under each method’s own recipe (batch 24) and trained until their val curve saturates—5 epochs for CLIP4Clip and X-CLIP, 10 for TS2-Net. X-Pool [ 3 ] is excluded because its query-conditioned pooling admits no precomputed index. The OT temperature ε \varepsilon and per-shot capacity c c are learnable and start at 0.07 and 0.89. The penalty weights w 1 , w 2 w_{1},w_{2} start at − 3 -3 ( softplus ⁡ ( − 3 ) ≈ 0.05 \mathrm{softplus}(-3){\approx}0.05 ).

blocks.en:
Evaluation. We report R@K (%) on all evaluation queries and on their Rel-Multi subsets.
For every method, the epoch is chosen by overall R@1 on the val splits above. The evaluation split is never used for selection. The performance of SALI in Tables 2 – 4 is averaged over three training runs with different seeds (seed standard deviation 0.2 R@1 overall, 0.4 on Rel-Multi). The baselines have no randomly initialized parameters and are single runs.

评价。 我们报告所有评价查询及其Rel-Multi子集的R@K(%)。

blocks.en: Main results (Table 2 ). Both SALI variants start from CLIP4Clip-meanP [ 2 ] . SALI+max raises overall R@5 and R@10 and Rel-Multi R@1 and R@5, while overall R@1 drops by 0.29 0.29 . Its Rel-Multi R@1 and R@5 are the highest of all methods. SALI+OT moves the other way. It has the highest overall R@1 of all methods but a Rel-Multi R@1 below CLIP4Clip-meanP.
blocks.zh: 主要结果(表2)。 两种 SALI 变体都起源于 CLIP4Clip-meanP [2]. SALI+max提高整体R@5和R@10,Rl-Multi R@1和R@5,而整体R@1下降0.290.29. 它的Rel-Multi R@1和R@5是所有方法中最高的. SALI+OT移动到另一边. 除CLIP4Clip-meanP以下的Rl-Multi R@1外,它在所有方法中的总R@1.

blocks.en: Ablation (Table 3 ). Each comparison changes one setting. (i) The penalty raises Rel-Multi R@1 in every configuration, by less than one query each, and never lowers overall R@1. The two highest Rel-Multi R@1 values of Table 3 are both penalty rows. The penalty’s Rel-Multi R@1 gain is largest with OT training and greedy max at inference, whereas the penalty trained with greedy max lowers Rel-Multi R@5. (ii) For the two OT-trained models, switching to greedy max at inference raises Rel-Multi R@1 by about four queries, far beyond the seed standard deviation, at a cost of 0.7 0.7 – 0.8 0.8 overall R@1. We interpret this as follows: at inference the transport plan spreads each text embedding’s mass over several shots, which helps ordinary queries but hurts relational ones, whose evidence is one shot per person.
blocks.zh: 差额(表3) 每次比较都会改变一个设置。 (i) 处罚将Rl-Multi R@1在每个配置中提高,每次不足一个查询,并且绝不降低总体R@1. 表3中两个最高的Rel-Multi R@1值都是罚行. Rel-Multi R@1的处罚收益最大, (二) 对于两个经过OT训练的模型,在推论中切换到贪婪的最大值,通过大约4次询问,使Rel-Multi R@1上升,远远超出了种子标准偏差,成本为0.7–0.8总R@1. 我们对此的解释如下:推论一下,运输计划将每个文本的质点分布在几个镜头上,这帮助了普通的询问,但伤害了关系上的询问,他们的证据是每人一枪。

blocks.en: Controls. SALI mixes two scores through the gate and continues training a CLIP4Clip-meanP checkpoint, so its gains could come from ensembling or from longer training. (a) Ensembling: we train three CLIP4Clip-meanP models with different seeds and average the similarity scores of each pair. Over the better model of the pair, the average gains at most 0.88 0.88 in overall R@1 and R@5, and at most 2.65 2.65 and 1.77 1.77 in Rel-Multi R@1 and R@5. (b) Longer training: four more epochs of CLIP4Clip-meanP lower R@1 and R@5. SALI+max’s gains in overall R@5 and Rel-Multi R@1 and R@5 exceed the gains of both experiments; in Rel-Multi R@1 the margin over the largest ensembling gain is only 0.30 0.30 .
blocks.zh: 控制系统 SALI将两个分数混合通过大门,并继续训练一个CLIP4Clip-meanP检查站,因此它的收益可以来自于综艺或更长的训练. (a) 组合:我们培训3名CLIP4Clip-mean 具有不同种子的P模型,并且平均每对的相似性得分. 在对子的更好模型上,平均收益最多为0.88 0.88 R@1和R@5,最多为2.65 2.65和1.77 R@1和R@5。 (b) 更长时间的培训:四个世纪的CLIP4Clip-meanP低R@1和R@5. SALI+max在总体R@5和Rl-Multi R@1和R@5的增益超过了两个实验的增益;在Rel-Multi R@1中,最大综艺增益的比值仅为0.300.30.

blocks.en: Table 3: Training vs. inference configuration on CM (setting of Table 2 , 3 seeds). Train/Infer: matching operator (max: greedy max; OT) and whether the film-grammar penalty (pen) is applied. Shaded: penalty in training only, penalty-free greedy max at inference; bold: best per column.
blocks.zh: 表3:关于CM的培训与推论配置(设置表2,3种子). 列车/推断:匹配操作员(最大:贪婪最大;OT)以及是否适用电影-语法处罚(pen). 阴影:只在训练中处罚,在推论中免罚贪婪;粗体:每栏最好.

blocks.en: Mechanism. In all runs of Tables 2 and 3 , the learned penalty weights stay near their start ( 0.05 0.05 ). To test a strong penalty, we trained max+pen with the weights started at 0.31 0.31 , 0.67 0.67 and 2.1 2.1 (3 seeds each). With the penalty at inference, Rel-Multi R@10 falls as the weight grows, from 56.9 56.9 (SALI+max) to 56.3 56.3 , 54.3 54.3 and 40.4 40.4 : the penalty pushes the correct videos down rather than the distractors. Without the penalty at inference, all three models equal SALI+max within seed noise, and OT+pen models trained with the same weights behave alike. Even a strong penalty thus leaves the encoder unchanged. In short, the Rel-Multi gains come from greedy max at inference (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 机制。 在表2和表3的所有栏目中,所学的处罚加权数都接近起始数(0.050.05)。 为了测试重罚,我们训练了最大+彭,开始重量为0.31 0.31、0.67 0.67和2.1.1(各3个种子)。 根据推断,Rel-Multi-R@10随着重量的增长而下降,从56.9 56.9 (SALI+max)下降到56.3 56.3 , 54.3 54.3 和 40.4 40.4 : 惩罚将正确的视频推向下,而不是分散视线. 如果没有推断的处罚,所有三种型号在种子噪声中均等于SALI+max,而训练有相同重量的OT+pen型号表现相同. 即使惩罚很严厉,编码器也保持不变。 简言之,Rel-Multi收益来自最贪婪的推断(表3)。

blocks.en: Generality (Table 4 ). On ActivityNet [ 19 ] , SALI+max keeps overall recall on par with CLIP4Clip-meanP while Rel-Multi R@1 rises by 12 12 points and R@5 by 4 4 . On MSR-VTT [ 18 ] , overall R@1 drops by 1.4 1.4 while overall R@5 and relational R@1 and R@5 rise. SALI+OT is on par with SALI+max overall and below it on relational queries on both datasets.
blocks.zh: 概论(表4). 在活动网[19]上,SALI+max保持与CLIP4Clip-mean等值的整体回溯. Rel-Multi R@1上升12个12点,R@5上升4个4点。 在MSR-VTT[18]上,总体R@1下降1.41.4,而总体R@5和关系R@1和R@5上升. SALI+OT总体上与SALI+max相当,下面是两个数据集的关联查询.

blocks.en: Limitation. Shot-level matching costs overall R@1 on short clips: on MSR-VTT (10–30 s, 12 frames per video) SALI+max is 1.4 1.4 R@1 below CLIP4Clip-meanP. On ActivityNet, whose videos have the same median shot count but run about two minutes with 64 frames, SALI+max raises overall R@1 and raises Rel-Multi recall by a wide margin. Our experiments do not tell whether the short clips or the small frame budget (12 frames) cause the drop on MSR-VTT.
blocks.zh: 限制。 短片上拍摄级别的匹配费用为R@1:MSR-VTT(10-30s,每段视频12帧) SALI+max在CLIP4Clip-meanP下方为1.41.4R@1. On ActiveNet的视频中位点数相同,但运行约2分钟,有64帧,SALI+max提升了整体R@1,并提升了Rel-Multible record的宽角. 我们的实验并不知道短片片段还是小帧预算(12帧)导致MSR-VTT的下降.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: SALI represents a clip by one embedding per shot and matches the query and its subject and object against the shots with greedy max or OT. The gains on relational queries come from greedy max at inference. A film-grammar penalty in fine-tuning adds a small, consistent shift. Built on CLIP4Clip-meanP, SALI+max achieves the highest Rel-Multi R@1 and R@5 on Condensed Movies with overall recall on par, and SALI+OT the highest overall R@1. SALI+max also raises Rel-Multi recall on ActivityNet by a wide margin and improves relational queries on MSR-VTT at a cost of 1.4 overall R@1.
blocks.zh: SALI代表一个片段,每个片段嵌入一个片段,并与查询及其对象和对象匹配,以贪婪的最大或OT对镜头. 关系查询的收益来自最贪婪的推断。 微调中的电影语法惩罚增加了一个小的,一贯的转变. SALI+max建于CLIP4Clip-meanP上,实现最高的Rel-Multile R@1和在凝聚式电影上R@5,整体召回平面,SALI+OT则达到最高的总R@1. SALI+max 也提高了关于活动的Rel- 多召回 净差很大,并改进了MSR-VTT上的关系查询,费用为1.4总R@1.
